tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rā hu la'i skong gso khrag mtsho 'khyil ba bzhugs/hūm̐ 'grub par gyur cig mthu stobs dbang phyug gtso/ /rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal la
༄༅/ /rā hu la'i skong gso khrag mtsho 'khyil ba bzhugs/hūm̐ 'grub par gyur cig mthu stobs dbang phyug gtso/ /rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal la

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rā hu la'i skong gso khrag mtsho 'khyil ba bzhugs/

hūm̐ 'grub par gyur cig mthu stobs dbang phyug gtso/ /rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gza' mchog chen po 'jigs byed rā hu+u la/ / thugs dam skong ba'i cho ga brjod par bya/ /de la gza'i bshos bu dgus bskor rtse la ling dmar gyis brgyan pa/ skyu gu brgyad dang ril bu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ dar nag gi 'phan lding bcas pa bsham/ tshogs dang spyan gzigs mang po dang*/ spos dang tshil chen gyi dud pa dang*/ rnga dang rol mo bsgrag cing*/ rang nyid pad+ma thong phreng gi nga rgyal gyis mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid rdo rje thong phreng rtsal/ mthing nag me yi klong na bzhugs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs hūm̐ sgra sgrogs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje thod dbyug gdengs/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dor stabs te/ /sbrul dang thong phreng 'bar bas brjid/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'phro 'du las/ /sprul pa'i khro chung glog ltar 'khyugs/ /mtshon cha'i mi ri stong khams 'bar/ /rlung yang 'gyu ba'i skabs med na/ /bar chad bgegs rnams smos ci dgos/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma tho phreng rtsal/ u tsa ta ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas mtshams bcad/ mdun du gza' mchog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis gsal te/ spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /yang sprul mi bzad 'bar ba'i skur ston pa/ /gza' mchog chen po 'jigs byed rā hu la/ /dang nyid chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs shig /snyigs dus mi bzad lnga brgya tha ma 'dir/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis gdug pa 'dul don du/ /thugs nyid zhi ba chos dbyings rnams dag kyang*/ /drag gtum mi bzang thugs rjes sku bzhengs shig /hūṃ zhe sdang 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yak+ṣa dza la dam la shog /'dod chags 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje glog 'gyu dam la shog

/'dod chags zhe sdang 'bar ba las/ /sprul pa gza' bdud dam la shong*/ /ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /ljang sngon chen mo dam la shog /dgra lha'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /drang srong dkar ser=/ /klu bdud rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bdud po rā dza=/ /srin po'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bhi tri pa tra=/ /dmu bdud rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dmu bdud chen po=/ /gshin rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /du ba mjug ring dam la shog /klu btsan rol pa'i=/ /khyab 'jug chen po=/ /sde brgyad tshogs kyi=/ /sgra gcan chen po=/ /shar phyogs nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas/ / stag srin zor gdong =/ /lho phyogs nam mkha'i= /bam srin dred gdong = / nub phyogs nam= /kong sren ba lang gdong can= /byang phyogs nam= /'brog srin chu srin gdong can= /so so'i gnas dang pho brang nas/ /sprul pa'i gza' brgyad dam= /rgyu skar nyer brgyad dam= /lha srin sde brgyad= /klu 'bum tshogs ba'i pho brang nas/ /rdo rje legs pa dam= /srin po 'bum gyi pho brang nas/ /lha mo nag mo dam= /gshin rje 'bum gyi pho brang nas/ /bshan pa dmar nag dam= /gnam sman 'bum kyi pho brang nas/ /tshe 'dzin ma bzhi= /ro langs 'bum gyi pho brang nas/ /pho nya nag mo= /las mkhan 'bum gyi pho brang nas/ /nag po 'dzum med= /gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya dang*/ /yang sprul lha srin 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ / nam mkha' dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /sku mdog dud kha tse re re/ /dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs ya la la/ /dar nag ru mtshon phya ra ra/ mi rkang gling bu tse re re/ spyan stong me ru 'u ru ru/ / bshugs pa'i glu len kyu ru ru/ /rngams pa'i nga ro di ri ri/ /dpal gyi bro chen chems se chem/ /'jigs pa'i glu len tse re re/ /glog dmar zhags pa khyugs se khyug /tshur byon tshur byon gnas 'dir byon/

/pho brang rab mdzes gzhal yas 'dir/ /gza' bdud 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /hrī shag ru raṃ/ nā ga tsit+ta traṃ/ ma ma yo bra gh+raṃ/ ha he yo ge sha la dza dzaḥ/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'jigs byed chen po gza' mchog rā hu la/ /sring bzhi sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /nyi zla pad+ma zhing chen gdan steng du/ / dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs par bsam/ dang po phyag dang mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ che ba'i che mchog 'jigs byed rā hu la/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor bcas la/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la pra tits+tsha hoḥ phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /spos dang me tog snang gsal la sogs dang*/ /dza gad phud dang pañca a mṛ ta/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho rnams/ /dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dgongs klong dag pas mchod/ /oṃ ma hā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ dam ye bsre ba ni/ bdud rtsi 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis/ /rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig gnyan po gcig tu bsre/ /'go zhing stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ rā hu la sarba pañca a mṛ ta sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' na/ khyed kyang dam las ma 'da' zhig /gnyis ka dam las mi 'da' 'tshal/ /dam las gal te 'das pa na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar skye ta re/ /de bas dam tshig gnyan po srungs/ /oṃ rā hu la sa ma ya na ra kan/ de nas tshogs gtor oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ pho brang rab mdzes gzhal yas 'dir/ /'bru bzang sna tshogs bshos bu brtsigs/ /dar zab mang po rgyan du btags/ /'bru bcud mngar gyi skyems su 'bul/

/rta dang rnga mong bya yi tshogs/ /gser dngul dar zab g.yu yi tshogs/ /sha chang dkar dmar mchod pa rnams/ /gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / gsol zhig rol cig dgyes par mdzod/ /ba ling rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul/ / dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /chu sna stong gi mchod pa 'bul/ /me tog stong gi mchod pa 'bul/ /gsur chen dud pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /zhun chen mar me'i mchod pa 'bul/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /rkang gling rol mo'i mchod pa 'bul/ /gsol cig rol cig dgyes par mdzod/ /sha rul khrag rul nya rul dang*/ /btsos dang rjen sha sna tshogs dang*/ /ra mchin la sogs sha khrag tshogs/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman ga bur dang*/ /stag dom ba glang nya yi snying/ / sha sna snying sna khrag sna yis/ /gza' bdud yab yum 'khor bcas mchod/ / gsol zhig rol cig dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ ma hā pū dza la khā hi/ de nas skong bshags bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ /dmar chen rgyan gyi gtor ma dang*/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ /sha sna snying sna'i mchod pa yis/ /gza' mchog chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bskang ba'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /'bru bzang lha bshos sha chen spos/ /tshil chen snang gsal rol mo'i tshogs/ /sku blud spyan gzigs mang po dang*/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma yis/ /gza' mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang*/ / bskang ba'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /rak+ta dmar gyi ar+gha yis/ /ljong sngon drag po'i= /sha chen ri rab brtsegs pa yis/ /bdud po rog ti'i= /bsad khrag rba klong 'khrug pa yis/ khyab 'jug chen po'i= /spos sna snang gsal rol mo yis/ /drang srong dkar ser= /bam chen bcad 'phro ldan pa yis/ /bi tri'i pa tra'i= /ti ra zhing chen spungs pa yis/ /ha ling ka li'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dmar dang gsur chen dud pa yis/ /du ba mjug ring =

/spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor lo yis/ /sgra gcan zin gyi thugs= /sha khrag dmar chen gtor ma yis/ /sring mo bzhi yi= /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo yis/ /gza' chen brgyad kyi= /g.yos dang kha zas sna tshogs kyis/ / rgyu skar nyer brgyad= /sha sna snying sna 'bum phrag gis/ /lha srin sde brgyad= / bskang ngo bskang ngo gza' chen rnams/ /thugs dam gnyen po skong ba mdzod/ / chos skyong gza' bdud 'khor bcas la/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /dga' dang gus pa'i phyag cig 'tshal/ /mos dang dad pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rnal 'byor nyams chag skor bar mdzod/ /ces bskangs la bshags pa ni/ hūṃ chos rnams rnam dag namamakha' lta bu la/ /ma rig dbang gis nga dang bdag tu bzung*/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gyur pa'i/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /srung ma khyod bsten bsgrub par dam mnos kyang*/ /bsnyen sgrub ma tshang tshogs mchod chung ba dang*/ /bzlas grangs nyung zhing sbyor sgrol log pa dang*/ /thun zor ma bcol le lo'i rkyen dbang gis/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bar gyur to 'tshal/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bshags la yi ge brgya pa brjod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /mtshan gsol gza' mchog rā hu la/ / dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /hūm̐/ rig 'dzin srog shing gter gyi bdag /gtsug lag bstan srung mthu bo che/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha thugs dam can/ /dam nyams srog gcod gtso la bstod/ /hrīḥ khyab 'jug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin/ /'jigs pa'i lus la 'bar ba'i klong*/ /zhal dgu phyag bzhi rngams pa ste/ /'jig rten khams kyi drag rtsal can/ /gnam lcags thog gi bdag po ste/ /skyin thang ser ba 'bebs pa'i gtso/ /sprul pa chen po rdzu 'phrul can/

/mthu stobs chen po yongs kyi bdag /ri rab steng na lha yi gtso/ /rgya mcho'i gting na klu yi bdag /bar snang khams su sde brgyad gtso/ / dbu dgu srid pa gsum gyi bdag /mgo gcig lha min khro bo'i zhal/ /nyi ma zla ba grib mas gnon/ /gcig ni bzhad cing mdzes pa'i zhal/ /dges pas bka' yi bya ra mdzad/ /gcig ni khraus pa srin po'i gdong*/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zas zu za/ /gcig ni rngams pa'i za byed gdong*/ /gnam lcags me yi thog chen 'bengs/ /gcig ni 'jigs byed ma rungs pa/ /tsha grang 'thab pa'i rkan sgra sgrogs/ /gcig ni 'khrug byed drag po'i zhal/ /g.yo 'gul chen po'i ser chen 'bebs/ /gcig ni gtum chen ye shes zhal/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med/ /gcig ni stobs chen rdzu 'phrul zhal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar byed/ /gcig ni zhi ba lha yi zhal/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /steng gi phyogs na bya rog zhal/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par byed/ /glog 'dra ral gri zhags pa yis/ /sdang byed dgra po'i skye rgyud gcod/ /chu srin zhags pa dbyug pa yis/ /srid pa gsum yang dbang du sdud/ /ra yi mda' gzhu bsnams pa yis/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod/ /spyan stong me dpung sdang mig gis/ /dgra dang bgegs la 'bru tshugs lta/ /sku smad sa la brdab pa yis/ /'jig rten g.yo 'gul ldeg par byed/ /zhal nas hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgrogs pas/ /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud/ /sku mdog dud kha 'jigs pa yis/ khams gsum skye 'gro zil gyis gnon/ / sprul pa'i gza' bdun nag po khyod/ /'jig rten khams na 'gran zla bral/ / bdud dang dregs pa bran du 'khol/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung*/ / dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong mdzad pa/ /mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐/ khyod kyi bka' nyan gdong mo bzhi/ /rdzu 'phrul ri rab thal bar brlag /nad dang mtshon gyi bdag mo ste/

/mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐/ mi bzad drag gtum rngams pa'i tshogs/ /gza' brgyad lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ /rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad la sogs/ /pho nya yang sprul tshogs la bstod/ /de nas mnga' gsol ba ni/ spos dang tshil chen gyi dud pa btang zhing*/ phud dang rak+ta sbreng*/ rol mo bsgrag /me tog 'thor zhing*/ hoḥ dam can gza' yi dge bsnyen chen po sku mdog dud kha 'jigs pa'i mig gis gang ba/ dbu dgu rngams pa'i nga ros 'gengs pa/ thod sprul nyi zla'i phreng bas brjid pa/ zhal gdangs dug gi mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser 'bar ba/ zhal nas gdug pa'i ngan sngags sgrogs pa/ phyag bzhi g.yas dang g.yon gyi dang po chu srin rgyal mtshan dang ral gri 'bar ba/ 'og ma gnyis sbrul zhags dang mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ sku smad dug sbrul rab tu 'khyil pa/ thog dang ser chen rab tu 'bebs pa la 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ / mchod do/ /sdang ba'i dgra sod cig /gnod pa'i bgegs thul zhig /rkyen ngan dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zlog cig /tshe dang dpal 'byor spel zhig /bka' dang bstan pa srungs shig /'khor dang gang zag skyongs shig / bcol ba'i las mdzod cig /grub pa'i rtags phyungs shig /phrin las gnyan po mdzod cig /gzhan yang gza' mchog thugs kyi dgyes sde chen mo gdong mo mched bzhi ni/ /shar nas stag srin zor ba'i gdong can sku mdog dkar ser la stag dang sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa/ phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /lho na bam srin dred mo'i gdong can sku mdog ser nag mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ phyag na dbyug to dang sbrul zhags bsnams pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /nub na kong srin ba lang gi gdong can sku mdog dmar nag la stag gzig gis gzer kha gsol ba/ phyag na dgra sta dang zhags pa bsnams pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ / byang na 'brog srin chu srin gyi gdong can sku mdog ljang nag la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/

phyag na gtun shing dang zhags pa bsnams pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /sdang ba'i dgra sod cig /ces sogs brjod do/ /gzhan yang gza' mchog bka'i pho nya chen po/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs te gza' chen po brgyad/ bdud dang gshin rje la sogs te lha ma srin sde brgyad/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs te lha chen po brgyad/ dga' bo dang 'jog po la sogs te klu chen po brgyad/ brgya byin dang me lha la sogs te phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ smin drug dang snar ma la sogs rgyu skar nyer brgyad dang*/ mkha' la 'gro ba dang shugs kyis 'gro ba dang*/ smyo byed dang srul po la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la/ rak+ta dmar gyis mchod pa/ dza gad phud kyi mchod pa/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa/ sha chen gsur gyi dud pa/ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa/ rkang gling rol mo'i bye brag /spyan gzigs dang sku glud bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /sdang ba'i dgra sod cig /ces sogs nas phrin las gnyan po mdzod cig /ces pa'i bar brjod do/ /de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can/ / dam la gnas shing lha la phreng*/ khyod ni srung ma dam tshig can/ khyod ni mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can/ /dgongs dang gza' mchog rā hu la/ /sangs rgyas rin chen snying po dang*/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa dang*/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ khyod kyis khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /tha tshig gnyan po 'di min nam/ /rin chen snying pos bka' bsgos pa/ /bram ze'i khye'u khyab 'jug sprin/ /bstan pa srung bar dam chos shig /dam nyams sgrol bar dam chos shig /de tshe tha tshig de min nam/ /shākya thub pas bka' bsgos pa/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa'i tha ma la/ /bla ma la gnod sngags la sdang*/ khyad par dben gnas gnyan po 'jig /nyams pa de yi srog rtsa chod/

/de tshe tha tshig de min nam/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong ngo zhes/ /dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod do zhes/ khyod kyi khas blangs de min nam/ khyod kyi dam bca' gnyen po de/ /da lta rnal 'byor bdag bskul lo/ khas blangs bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐/ gza' bdud 'khor bcas tshur nyon cig /rgyal ba'i bka' la mi nyan med/ /zab mo'i don la mi sems med/ /mna' dang khrims la mi gnas med/ /zas dang skom la mi chags med/ /do nub khyed kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /nyams chag skong zhing zhig ral gso/ /lha la bshags bgyid sems 'khon sbyang*/ /phud 'dren zla bo'i gzhung gcig byed/ /do nub byams pa'i mna' gcig 'don/ / do nub snga ma'i gtang rag gtong*/ /do nub byi ma'i zhu ba 'bul/ /dang po phud kyis mi mchod du/ /gza' bdud 'khor bcas phud la dgyes/ /bar du tshogs kyis mi bskang du/ /'jigs byed chen po tshogs la dgyes/ /tha ma lhag mas mi mchod du/ /sring bzhi sde brgyad lhag la dgyes/ /lhag ma kha chus mi bran du/ /'khu ldog dam las 'das kyi dogs/ /rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre ru/ /sku gsung thugs dang mi 'brel med/ /phud la dges pa phud la rol/ /tshogs la dgyes pa tshogs la rol/ /lhag la dgyes pa lhag la rol/ /ba liṃ gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ /bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs*/ /hūm̐ hrīḥ gza' bdud chen po tshur gson cig /grogs la gzhung ngan mi srid kyis/ /rje la blon med mi srid kyis/ /byams la drin med mi srid kyis/ /mdza' la gdung med mi srid kyis/ /chos skyong mthu med mi srid kyis/ /chad don mi sgrub mi srid kyis/ / tshogs kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ / zas kyi ngo gcig khyod kyis gyis/ /chad pa'i gzhung gcig bdag gis

bsrang*/ /bdag gi tshig 'di khyod kyis nyon/ /sgrub pa'i gzhungani nga yis bsrang*/ /bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod/ /gnyis ka las kyi gzhu bsrang 'tshal/ /gnyis ka las kyi gnyer blang 'tshal/ /smras so chad do thugs dam can/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /phur kha zlog pa'i dus la babs/ /zor kha= /byad kha= /mi kha= /dal kha= /nad kha= /rims kha= / yams kha= /gdon kha = khram kha= /shwo kha= /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /gsol lo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs/ /sod cig thul zhig dgra dang bgegs/ /gtad do gnyer ro thugs dan can/ /bskal ba zhig kyang mi 'bral lo/ /thugs dam g.yel bar ma mdzad cig /thugs dang glo ba ci nyer mdzod/ /brtse gdung gdung sems ci cher mdzod/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ji lta bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ /'khor srungs rkyen zlog bar chad sol/ /le lo snyom las ma mdzad cig /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu ma mdzad cig /rnal 'byor bdag gi re ba skongs/ /tshe srings dpa' bskyed 'byor pa spel/ /snyan pa sgrubs la grags pa sgrogs/ /'jig rten gsum po dbang du sdus/ /dge dang zhi ba'i las 'grub dang*/ /rgyas dang dbang gis thams cad gnon/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzod cig /phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod/ /legs pa thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ /nyes pa thams cad 'gegs pa dang*/ /bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ /re ba thams cad bskang ba dang*/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ /ces brjod do/ /rgyun gyi skong gsol/ /de nas gtor ma btang la bkra shis brjod/ /gal te mngon spyod 'ba' zhig bsgrub na/ /nya bo bsgral nas gtor ma bstab pa ni/ /gri'am phur pa bsgril zhing*/ rang nyid drag po'i nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka/ / dam nyams sgrol ba'i ging chen te/ /sdang byed gdug pa'i dgra po 'di/ /lus srog dbugs dang phral bar bya/

/oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ che ge mo'i snying dang srog la yaṃ yaṃ/ rbad rbad/ hūm̐/ yang sprul chen po'i dus la babs/ /gza' mchog chen po'i dus la bababs/ /rā hu la yi dus= /gsod byed chen po'i= /sgrol ging chen po'i= /las mkhan= /mgo lus phrol la dbang po snubs/ /dus mtha' sdus la bla tshe phrogs/ /snying rtsa chod la srog rtsa gtubs/ /sring mo bzhi yi dus= gza' chen brgyad kyi= /rgyu skar nyer brgyad= /lha srin sde brgyad= /dam nyams bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ a nṛ mā ra ya srog la yaṃ yaṃ/ dam nyam dgra bo che ge mo'i/ /dbang po rnam lnga zhal du bstab/ /don snying rnam lnga zhal= yan lag rnam lnga= /bla tshe srog gsum= /klad rus rkang mar= /sha khrag tshil chen= /gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag 'ad/ི /yak+ṣa dz+wa la'i zhal du bstabs/ /rdo rje glog 'gyu'i zhal= /sras mchog gza' bdud= /gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i bla srog 'di/ /phung byed gza' bdud zhal= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i don snying 'di/ /drang sro mthu chen zhal= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i klad rus 'di/ /bdud po rog ti'i= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i nang khrol 'di/ /pi tri pa tra'i zhal= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i glo snying 'di/ /bi nu rā dza'i= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog dbugs 'di/ /du ba mjug ring = /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo dbang po lnga*/ /stag srin zor gdong = /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i skye mched drug /bam srin dred gdong = /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i phung po lnga*/ /kong srin ba lang zhal= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i mdangs dang bkrag /'brog srin chu srin zhal= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i rnam shes brgyad/ /sprul pa'i gza' brgyad zhal= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i drod dang dbugs/ /lha chen brgyad kyi zhal= /gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo'i mi nor zas/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad zhal=

/gsol= /dam nyams dgra bo 'khor bcas rnams/ / gza' mchog 'khor bcas zhal= /gsol= /phung zhing brlab pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ming gi lhag ma med par mdzod/ /dus la bab bo rā hu la/ /hre shag ru raṃ nā ge tsit+ta traṃ/ ma ma yo za 'gram ha he yo ge sha la dzaḥ hur thuṃ rbad sod/ mā ra ya shā tūn phaṭa/ ces gtor ma la bstab bo/ /de nas rigs kyi ded dpon rnams dgra la rbad pa ni/ /gtor ma dgra phyogs btegs la shin tu khros bas 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ gza' bdud chen po mthu rtsal can/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /bdag la bsdo ba'i dgra bo 'dis/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdos/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yis bshig /dben gnas gnyan po'i dkor la zos/ /srung ma gnyan po khyad du bsad/ khyod la mthu stobs med ces sgrogs/ /rnal 'byor bdag la phod du btsugs/ /byang chub sgrub tu ma ster ro/ /de bas gza' bdud rā hu la/ khyod la mthu stobs yod dam med/ /yod na da lta dus la babs/ /de skad cig nyid la snying khrag skyugs/ /'gyu ba'i dbugs chod tshe srog phrol/ /glo bur ye 'drog chen mo thong*/ /med na bsgrub pa don re chung*/ brten cing mchod pa 'bras re med/ / dam tshig gnyan po'i chad pa 'ong*/ /de bas gza' bdud rā hu la/ khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la babs/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo dam nyams 'di/ /pha khu yin kyang khyod kyis sgrol/ /do nub nam gyi gung smad la/ /dam nyams dgra bo ma bsgral na/ khyod kyi mthu stobs brdzun du che/ /brten cing bsgrub pa don re chung*/ /bsten kyang rgyab brten mi yong na/ khyod las ngan pa su zhig yod/ /da lta dgra bo ma bsgral na/ khyod kyi gnas 'di 'phrog go zer/ /rten dang pho brang 'jig gi zer/ /bdag cag dmangs su 'bebs so zer/ /de bas bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ /hūm̐/ gza' bdud chen po rā hu la/ /ri rab rtse nas bswo yis thob/ /lha dmag mang po'i dmag yar sdus/

/dgra bo'i yul du dmag sna drongs/ khyab 'jug chen pos dmag dpon mdzod/ /glo bur gri rgod 'khrag tu skyugs/ /phung byed rdul phran bzhin du rlog /'jigs byed sgra gdan rā hu la/ /rgya mtsho'i gting nas ku yis thob/ /ma mo bye ba'i dmag yar sdus/ / dgra bo'i yul du dmag sna drongs/ /drang srong chen pos dmag dpon mdzod/ / mdze 'bras phol mig lhog pa thong*/ /rims nad khrag nad dal yams thongs/ /gza' bdud nag po rā hu la/ /bsil ba'i tshal nas khu yis thob/ /nag po stong gi dmag yar sdus/ /dgra bo'i yul du dmag sna drongs/ /byin du rā dzas dmag dpon mdzod/ /gzer nad smyo 'bog gri rgod thongs/ /rdungs shig gtub cig rlung gis gtor/ /rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis/ /las mkhan chen po rā hu la/ /dur khrod gnas nas bswo yis thob/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag yar sdus/ /dgra bo yul du dmag sna drongs/ /bi tri pa tras dmag dpon mdzod/ /ser chen thog dang skar mda' rgyob/ /rims nad khrag gzer gri thabs thongs/ /srog bdag chen po rā hu la/ /nam mkha'i mthong na ku yis thob/ /gza' skar mang po dmag yar sdus/ /dgra bo'i yul du dmag sna drongs/ /du ba mjug ring dmag dpon mdzod/ /sad dang ser chen rgyu gzer phob/ /gnam lcags thog dang skar mda' rgyob/ /nad dang mtshon gyi bskal pa thongs/ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /skar ma phod can 'od po che/ /dgra bo'i steng du dmag sna drangs/ /'ur 'ur chem chem dmag sna drongs/ /srog gcod sring mo gdong bzhis mdzod/ / bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i/ /pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod/ /mo rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms/ /phung du chug la brlag par mdzod/ / rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /ming tsam med par phung du chug /dus la bab bo rā hu la/ /hūm̐/ gza' mchog chen po rā hu la/ /'jigs byed chen po drag rtsal can/ /pha ni srin la ma ni klu/

/klu srin tshogs pa'i mthu bo che/ / lus po gcig la mgo bo dgu /mgo lus med par mig gis gang*/ /sku mdog 'jigs pa'i dud kha la/ /phyag bzhi chu srin rgyal mtshan dang*/ /ral gri zhags pa mda' gzhu bsnams/ /lho nub mtshams nas sku bskyed la/ / dgra bo'i steng du da rgyug cing*/ /sring mo mched bzhi da rgyug cig /sprul pa'i gza' chen da rgyug cig /lha srin sde brgyad da rgyug cig /tshes grangs bzhi yi srog dag la/ /nub nas shar du rgyu tsam na/ /ma mo yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /rims nad 'bebs pa'i mthu bo che/ /ma mo'i ki kaṃ dgra la bh+yo/ /tshes grangs brgyad kyi dros chen la/ /shar lho nub byang rgyu tsam na/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po'i dmag dpon byed/ /yams nad 'bebs pa'i mthu bo che/ /dgra lha'i ki kaṃ dgra la bh+yo/ /tshes grangs bcu gcig dus tshod du/ /nam ni bying nas nam phyed la/ /byang nas lho ru rgyu tsam na/ /gshin rje yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /yams nad 'bebs pa'i= gshin rje'i ki kaṃ= /tshes grangs bco lnga'i nyin phyed la/ /lho nub byang shar rgyu tsam na/ /srin po yongs kyi= /gri rgod gtong ba'i= /srin po'i ki kaṃ= /tshes grangs bco brgyad nam phyed yol/ / shar nas nub tu rgyu tsam na/ /dmu rnams yongs kyi= /phyid nang gtod pa'i= / dmu yi ki kaṃ= /nyi shu gnyis kyi nyi phyed yol/ /nub byang shar lhor rgyu tsam na/ /btsan rnams yongs kyi= /gzer nad gtong ba'i= /btsan gyi ki kaṃ= / nyi shu lnga yi skya rengs la/ /lho nas byang du= /klu rnams yongs kyi= /mdze nad gtong ba'i= /klu yi ki kaṃ= /nyi shu dgu yi myur smar la/ /byang shar lho nub rgyu tsam na/ /lha rnams yongs kyi= /lha nad 'bebs pa'i= /lha yi ki kaṃ= /cho cho dam nyams dgra la cho/ /gza' mchog nyi ma dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /gza' mchog zla ba dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag la rol/

/gza' mchog mig dmar dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i rus la rol/ /gza' mchog lhag pa dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la rol/ /gza' mchog phur bu dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i nang khrol rol/ /gza' mchog pa sangs= /dam nyams dgra bo'i dbugs la rol/ / gza' mchog spen pa dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la rol/ / gdong mo mched bzhi dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la bh+yo/ /lha srin sde brgyad dgra la bh+yo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la bh+yo/ /cho cho gza' bdud 'khor bcas rnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du cho/ /nad kyi rlung dmar dgra la thob/ /mtshon gyi gru gu dgra la rkyongs/ /glo bur ye 'drog dgra la thob/ /ltas ngan phung rlag dgra la thongs/ /smyo 'bog rengs shing brgyal du chug /bdud chod mdangs 'phrogs dum bur gtubs/ /rlung gis gtong la stong par mdzod/ /rdul phran tsam yang med pa dang*/ /ming tsam med par rdul du rlog /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ kha sgyur dkar po khug dzaḥ tsa tsa khug shag thuṃ/ dri shag bu ru lu 'u+u badz+raḥ ma ta nag po dzaḥ ma ti pra ma sha dzaḥ gi raṃ pu shag lcags kyi raṃ dzaḥ yak+ṣa la rbad/ thogs med dzaḥ bh+rin chu khyer/ la thun dzaḥ ri byi nag po stong rgya dzaḥ bud ya bud ya/ shak+sha thun/ snying chen zung*/ lcags sgrog nag po sa sdoms/ /nam mthong nag po thibs/ /mi rengs skya bo'i srin lam dmar po phye/ che ge'i tsit+ta mā ra ya rbud/ hri du ru na thuṃ 'ub/ rā tsa tri ga nan/ rbad thuṃ ri li li/ he ba/ ri sa/ ra kha/ ra ho ra ti sho zon zon/ ya ma thun rbad/ ces brjod/ dul mo rdul lo/ /de nas rang gi gnas su bkra shis brjod/ dge ba 'di yis dgra bgegs dus mtha' bstung*/ /mthu chen drag po'i grags pa rgyas par shog /gza' bdud kyi skong gso khrag mtsho 'khyil ba zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) rā hu la'i skong gso khrag mtsho 'khyil ba/ -PAGE 214--PAGE 229--PAGE 213-
